import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    w = int(line[0])
    m = int(line[1])
    
    digits = []
    while m > 0:
        digits.append(m % w)
        m //= w
    
    ok = True
    for i in range(len(digits)):
        if digits[i] > 1:
            digits[i] += 1
            if digits[i] == w:
                j = i
                while j < len(digits) and digits[j] >= w:
                    digits[j] = 0
                    if j + 1 == len(digits):
                        digits.append(1)
                    else:
                        digits[j + 1] += 1
                    j += 1
            if digits[i] > 1:
                ok = False
                break
    
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
